## Core Divisions
1. **Property Marketplace & Verified Listings:** 100% DTCP and RERA approved gated residential plots, luxury duplex villas, and independent homes across Trichy with 0% buyer commission and verified parent deeds.
2. **Civil Engineering Turnkey Construction:** Architect-supervised home construction with branded materials (TATA Tiscon 550D, Ultratech Super), transparent milestone billing, 10-year structural warranty, and fixed rate tiers (Basic: ₹1,950/sq.ft, Standard: ₹2,250/sq.ft, Premium: ₹2,650/sq.ft).
3. **PropTech & Market Intelligence:** Ground-verified micro-market dossiers comparing exact SRO guideline valuations with market transactions across 8 Trichy growth corridors (Olaiyur Ring Road, Panjappur Bus Terminus, K.K. Nagar, Vayalur Road, Samayapuram, Thanjavur Highway).
4. **Real Estate Academy & Buyer Education:** Free Tamil and English educational guides explaining 30-year Encumbrance Certificates (EC), Patta/Chitta online scrutiny, FMB sketch matching, and avoiding unapproved Panchayat layout traps.
5. **Promoter Studio & Channel Partner Representation:** Mandate-driven sales representation, 4K aerial drone walkthroughs, bilingual AI qualification, and access to a 100+ broker network in Trichy.

## The Six End-to-End Promoter Services in Trichy
- **01. Real Estate Channel Partner Representation:** Sole and co-exclusive sales mandates taking active closing responsibility, lead vetting, and Sub-Registrar coordination.
- **02. Targeted Real Estate Digital Marketing:** High-intent buyer campaigns profiling homebuilders and NRI Tamil diaspora investors (Singapore, Malaysia, UAE, USA) with 4K drone cinematography and landing pages.
- **03. AI Lead Qualification & Sales Automation:** Sub-second bilingual (Tamil & English) WhatsApp and web conversational intelligence qualifying buyers by budget, road width, and construction timeline.
- **04. Accompanied Site-Visit & Field Coordination:** Free cab transit pickup from central Trichy, on-site survey stone demonstration, and presentation of original DTCP approvals and road gift deeds.
- **05. Broker & Channel Partner Distribution Network:** Access to 100+ active Trichy brokers with timestamped lead registration protection and escrow-settled commission governance.
- **06. Guided Home Construction & Bank Loan Advisory:** Objective requirement profiling, matching with DTCP inventory, 80% bank loan sanction assistance (SBI, HDFC, LIC), and 30-year legal due diligence.
